text: A program is generated by repeatedly expanding one non-terminal at a time. Start with the initial symbol: (1) (expr) Step 1: expand the root (2) (expr) + (expr) Step 2: expand the left non-terminal (3) x+ (expr) Step 3: expand the remaining non-terminal (4) x+sin((expr)) Step 4: terminate (5) x+sin(x) Final program f(x) = x +sin(x)
